_note: Fitted 2026-09-02 to the kind of show See Saw FEATURES, not merely lists. Requires full Sonnet judge coverage: 277 verdicts were run for $3.26 on 2026-09-02, taking judge_v1/claude-sonnet-5 to 321/321 pool shows (189/189 in window). Do NOT use this preset with partial judge coverage - judge carries 0.62 of the score, so an unjudged show scores near zero and is invisible. TARGET: the positives are the 10 in-pool shows on See Saw's Featured (7) or Editor's Picks (10) lists; the hard negatives are the 15 shows on See Saw's 'All Current Shows' that they cover but passed over. That second comparison is the honest test - it cannot be won by excluding museums or by preferring well-scraped pages, which is what the easier pool-wide metric rewards. RESULTS on the 2026-09-01 snapshots: AUC 0.760 ranking See Saw's picks above the shows See Saw passed over (the previous seesaw-overlap preset scored 0.600 there, statistically indistinguishable from the untuned default's 0.627 - the dense Sonnet judge, not the weighting, is what moved this); AUC 0.926 vs the rest of the in-window pool; nDCG@10 0.635; P@5 1.00 and P@10 0.70 against See Saw's picks; 7 of the 10 in the 12-show feed; all 6 in-pool Featured shows above threshold. Karma 'Dictation from the Other Side' now ranks 18 and sits at feed slot 9 - under seesaw-overlap it was rank 138 and PROVABLY unreachable (Pareto-dominated on every feature by 13 other shows) purely because it had no verdict. HELD OUT: leave-one-venue-out (refit without a venue's shows, then score only that venue) gives AUC 0.647 against 0.733 fitted, so expect roughly 0.65 not 0.76 on shows this fit never saw; per-venue spread is 0.40-0.93 on 10 positives, so treat one week's number as noisy. Weight rationale from single-feature AUC on the hard comparison: judge 0.737 (it is the only feature that discriminates taste, and the judge_v1 rubric is explicitly written against See Saw's Featured feed); closing_soon 0.633; quality 0.590; venue 0.567; press 0.567; and keyword 0.397, opening_recency 0.443, artist_heat 0.480, wiki_heat 0.513 are at or below chance and are zeroed. CAVEAT on closing_soon: 0.06 is small but it is fitted to ONE capture date on which See Saw's picks happened to be closing (mean 0.800 vs 0.533). It buys P@5 1.00 over 0.80 and one extra feed slot; drop it to 0 for a timing-blind feed, which costs little and removes a plausible artifact. exclude_museums is the single most important gate - turning it off drops P@5 from 1.00 to 0.40. max_per_venue 2 mirrors See Saw, which lists up to 2 shows per venue. Threshold 0.5 admits 25 of 123 in-window galleries; max_n 12 then picks the feed, so a Featured show that misses the feed is gated max_n, not below_threshold. Sibling preset seesaw-overlap.json fits the easier 'which of our shows does See Saw list at all' target with the Sonnet+Opus mean judge.
